description: '''Lounge music''' is a type of [[easy listening]] or [[light music]] 'emerging from the era of light music on the radio (the 1920s and 1930s)'. The range of lounge music encompasses [[beautiful music]]–influenced instrumentals, and modern [[electronica]] (with [[chill-out music|chillout]] and [[downtempo]] influences), while remaining thematically focused on its retro–[[space age]] cultural elements.
